decisions.reason: The candidate already requires permanent badges to be visible, and its same-message update separately captures the mint-number referral-code metadata. The badge milestones and cosmetic effect do not invalidate or necessarily change its current metadata attributes.
The candidate's existing message-143 event already includes the on-chain referral-milestone badge explanation and its current cosmetic and leaderboard role.
Badge award milestones and cosmetic effects do not alter the Chainlink VRF winner-selection method, ticket weighting, or prize eligibility rules.
The badge decision does not change the mint price, founder allocation, referral commission, or prize-pool destinations.
The badge decision does not change secondary-sale royalties, their allocation, visibility, or ticket-generation behavior.
Referral-milestone badges are independent of the Big Block prize amount, winner count, funding sources, and draw trigger.
The badge decision does not alter the manual one-click prize-claim flow or its Winners-page location.
Referral-milestone badges are independent of the Small Block prize amount, winner count, pool funding, and draw condition.
Badges awarded for referral milestones do not change the random prize-ticket allocation used when no referral code is supplied.
Possible future badge utility in token-gated chats is speculative and does not resume or otherwise modify the currently deferred Discord server requirement.
Badge storage, milestones, and cosmetic effects do not change the Transak provider, supported payment methods, conversion behavior, or wallet requirements.
Badge referral milestones are distinct from Small and Big Block ticket issuance, eligibility windows, counters, and post-draw reset behavior.
